operations.summary: Differential flux of one bin: signal mean / (exposure * bin_width). No background: Garwood interval for any count; known background: Feldman-Cousins on s >= 0; uncertain background: Cousins-Highland by default or a seeded profile-FC; naive subtraction only on request, labelled approximate. No bound is negative; flux_upper_limit is added when the lower end is 0, flux_syst_exposure when an exposure uncertainty is given

inputs.name: counts
inputs.constraint: integer >= 0, up to the core/stats mean limit (1e5); with a background the Feldman-Cousins grid needs a total mean <= 500 (exit 3 otherwise)

inputs.name: exposure
inputs.constraint: finite, > 0; geometric factor or effective area times live time times solid angle, one number per bin. Whether it contains the efficiency is the caller's statement (recipe operator divide_exposure or divide_effective_exposure); the tool cannot tell

inputs.name: bin_width
inputs.constraint: finite, > 0; in the unit the flux is differential in (per GV: 600 for a 1.2-1.8 TV bin; never a width in TV for a flux per GV)

inputs.name: bin_width_unit
inputs.constraint: one of GV, GeV, GeV/n, TeV, TV; names the unit {E} of bin_width and is echoed in the output

inputs.name: method
inputs.constraint: auto, garwood, feldman-cousins, cousins-highland, profile-fc or naive

inputs.name: status
inputs.constraint: one of the core artifact_statuses; echoed as status

failure_states.meaning: core/stats could not bracket an interval end; the reason is on stderr and nothing is printed on stdout
an argument is missing, malformed or out of range (including a missing --bin-width-unit, or a method that does not fit the background inputs); the reason is on stderr and nothing is printed on stdout
the method's grid or mean limit is exceeded (Feldman-Cousins total mean above 500); the message names the alternative (profile-fc or an asymptotic construction); nothing is printed on stdout
